text: Not everyone who visits the store has a portal login, like a friend buying a gift card. Here's what a guest can and can't do.
This is the store with nobody logged in.
A guest pays with a new card. Gift cards and one-time items are fine. Prescriptions, pets and auto-ship need the portal login.
Gift cards first. This opens the gift card page.
Pick the amount. There's also an other amount button.

A prescription is different.
Prescriptions.
Heartworm and flea chewable.
A guest is asked to log in. There's no add to cart.
Anyone with a code can check a gift card's balance.
Type the code,
and check.
It shows what's left, and it works in the store, at a visit, or on a bill in the portal.
The most common mistakes: telling a family with a portal login to check out as a guest, so they lose their saved card and member price, and promising a guest a prescription without a login.
Remember: a guest pays with a new card and can buy gift cards and one-time items. Prescriptions, pets and auto-ship need the portal login.
